currentSourceCorrections.resolvedMeaning: Review one exact immutable project version for a declared purpose and selected quality, rights, provenance, or approval scope, with a comment, approval, rejection, or request-changes action under current assigned reviewer authority and explicit scope/expiry disposition. Result evidence remains linked to the reviewed version and does not mutate it or grant rights clearance or publication authority.

P0 defines no product-wide idempotency evidence duration. Expiry, deletion, or unavailability leaves the same scoped identity UNKNOWN until authoritative reconciliation; a fresh key or request cannot bypass unresolved work; artifact retention expiry remains independent. PDP-1 selects the exact approved per-operation duration and storage, lookup, and expiry contract.
